lines.en: I walk on fallen leaves, slowly.
I come out of the birch wood.
My long arms hang to my knees.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挨到你身边。
lines.en: I close in on you one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我朝你走的方向偏过去。
lines.en: I angle toward where you're headed.

lines.zh: 我从花森林的树影里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the flowering wood's shade.
I back away, my face toward you.

lines.zh: 我沿着林线慢慢踱步，翅膀半张。
lines.en: I pace along the treeline, wings half spread.
I stand behind the tree, still.
My wings are folded behind me.
My hands hang, long.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里有什么在动。
lines.en: I listen for movement in the wood.
My horns have dulled a little.

lines.zh: 我在等我该出现的时候。
lines.en: I wait for my moment to appear.

lines.zh: 我这双长手，一伸就够到你。
lines.en: These long arms reach you in one stretch.
I leave no sound of breathing.
I roll my shoulders back.
Wind passes through my wings; it's cold.
I've stayed in the dark forest too long.
My eyes shine in the tree shadows.
I slowly open one hand.
I've watched you from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我的手指比你整条手臂长。
lines.en: My fingers are longer than your whole arm.
You stepped back; perfect.
I twitch my mouth; call it a smile.
That sword of yours is too short.
Your shadow twitched.
I know the rhythm of your walk.
I'm in no hurry; the wood is large.
I've closed the path behind you.
My horns catch the light in the dark.
You can still run; go on.
Standing, I'm a little shorter than the trees.
You smell of fear.
I retreat behind the tree, slowly.

lines.zh: 黑翼裂开，羽毛掉了两片。
lines.en: A tear in my black wing; two feathers fall.
I give a low laugh.
I press my shoulder without a word.
I don't cry out; it would disturb the wood.
I brace on my knees and stand straight.
I retreat into deeper shadow.
I'm still standing; don't celebrate.
Your breathing comes faster and rougher.

lines.zh: 那点光在树林里很明显。
lines.en: That light shows plainly in the wood.
What you hold sways gently.
I lean your way.
You've backed to the roots.
Your blood smells fresh.
Another half tree closer.

lines.zh: 你把武器放低，我会快些。
lines.en: Lower the weapon and it'll be quicker.
There's one path through this wood.
I don't like chasing far.
You're still in my shadow.
You hit me like a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 我的手扶住你的肩，很凉。
lines.en: My hand takes your shoulder, cold.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，把你让过去。
lines.en: I give a step and let you pass.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，落叶都起来了。
lines.en: We meet, and the leaves rise.

lines.zh: 你的刀在我手臂上滑开。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my arm.
I stand against you, unmoving.
I swing half a circle past your side.
You push; I don't budge.
Another steps out of the tree shadows.
Her wings are more whole than mine.

lines.zh: 我们站在同一片阴影里。
lines.en: We stand in the same shadow.
She tilts her head over.
We walk together, light of step.
Her horn has a chip.

lines.zh: 我们不需要灯也能看见。
lines.en: We need no lamp to see.
Two long shadows, one wood.
We wait for full dark together.
I pick up your lamp and pinch it out.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的剑拾起来，折了。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped sword and snap it.
I catch a bird and let it go.
I crush the fallen fruit.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片羽毛，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a feather and look at it.

lines.zh: 我把你的帽子挂到树上。
lines.en: I hang your hat on a branch.
I pick up a cloth strip and wind it round my hand.
I drive your arrow into the bark.
I wipe out the writing on the ground.
I lift a dead branch and throw it.
You stepped on my leaves.
I've watched you walk all along.
I begin drawing in toward you.
You're in my way.

lines.zh: 你的灯在黑暗里太扎眼。
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright in this dark.
I've circled from over there.
When you look back, I'm there.
Retreating is an admission.
Three counts, and talking is over.
Every sound in the wood has stopped.
I follow, a few trees behind.
You go left; I keep left.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直落在你身上。
lines.en: My shadow stays on you.
I wear the distance down, little by little.
You've started running; I know.
I slip from tree to tree ahead.

lines.zh: 你听见落叶的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the leaves?
I stop to listen to you pant.
There's no other way from where you're headed.
I wait for you to reach the roots.
Running now won't help.
I reach and take your shoulder.
Death Claw comes down.
One swing, and you fly.
I raise a knee into your chest.
That was light, testing you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子往上提。
lines.en: I take your collar and lift.
It blocked and gave half a step.
I close in from behind.
My wings fold around you.
I withdraw and stand under the tree.
I used very little strength.
A figure appears in the tree shadow.
I step out from behind the tree, slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的树够高，遮得住我。
lines.en: The trees here are tall enough to hide me.
I spread my wings once.
The wind in the wood has changed.

lines.zh: 我听见有人踩碎了叶子。
lines.en: I hear someone breaking leaves.
I glance at the treetops overhead.
My horns still carry dew.

lines.zh: 我站在林间小路的尽头。
lines.en: I stand at the end of the forest path.
I've walked this wood a long while.
I land beside the path.

lines.zh: 火光让我眯起眼，我往后撤。
lines.en: The firelight makes me squint; I pull back.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，落得很稳。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and land steady.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我咳得很难看。
lines.en: Water fills my throat; I cough badly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推着撞上树干。
lines.en: The blast drives me into a trunk.
An arrow sticks in my wing.
A light coils around my horns.
I haven't tasted anything warm in ages.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮整片林子，我无处可藏。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole wood; nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 这里没有树，也没有影子。
lines.en: No trees here, and no shadows.
